 Diop salvages point for Monaco after Kouassi's red 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Monaco 1-1 LOSC at the Stade Louis-II as the visitors climbed to first place and the hosts slipped to second in Ligue 1.
 In the 24th minute, Ethan Mbappé ran through to slot low from Soriba Diaoune's through ball, putting LOSC ahead.
 OneFootball Videos
 Nianzou Kouassi was sent off (66.) with a straight red, leaving the visitors under pressure.
 After first half changes, substitute Edan Diop levelled (74.) with a precise drive from distance after Jordan Teze teed him up for Les Rouge et Blanc.
 Berke Ozer made five saves as LOSC defended deep, parrying Vanderson's headers and dealing with a stream of late crosses.
 Ansu Fati departed injured early, forcing Les Rouge et Blanc into a reshuffle.
 Les Rouge et Blanc registered 20 attempts and had 63.5% possession. LOSC produced four attempts and made 40 clearances to see the game out.
 Next, Les Rouge et Blanc visit Paris FC in Ligue 1. LOSC host Lens in the league.
